title: Fix: $RefParser.dereference + computeDiff block the main thread for 100s+ on large specs
completed_note: Shipped across three commits before this reconcile: eb7d029 offloaded $RefParser + computeDiff to src/workers/diff-worker.js with src/hooks/use-diff-worker.js lifecycle; c3eed71 surfaced real worker errors and pre-bundled $RefParser for dev; 0aa8694 polyfilled Buffer in the worker context. FetchProgress already animates through dereference/diff stages (DiffViewer.jsx:107-125). Cancel affordance (step-4) is partial — Reset clears results but does not terminate the worker; enqueued as wp-fix-diff-worker-cancel-affordance.

done: commit 3af08da fixed two quadratic hot paths in computeDiff
Despite that fix, large GitHub specs (multi-MB, thousands of $refs) still block the main thread
Browser reports 'message handler took 111038ms' inside React scheduler during dereference+diff
Fetch pipeline (ADR-018) is unaffected — issue is purely post-fetch compute

notes: handleLoadSpecs in DiffViewer.jsx calls $RefParser.dereference then computeDiff, both sync-on-main-thread
FetchProgress banner dismisses when fetch completes but the UI stays frozen afterwards — users get no feedback during the 100s compute
Migration to Web Worker keeps the domain pure — diff-algorithm already has zero I/O so it can ship to a worker as-is

steps.description: Create src/workers/diff-worker.ts. Web Worker that receives { oldSpec, newSpec } and posts back { results, refsResolved }. Internally imports @apidevtools/json-schema-ref-parser and src/core/domain/diff-algorithm. Uses vite's `?worker` suffix for bundling.
steps.done_condition: worker file compiles; vite dev+build succeed; manual postMessage roundtrip returns DiffResult[]

steps.description: Add src/hooks/use-diff-worker.js that manages the worker lifecycle (spawn on first use, reuse, terminate on unmount). Returns { runDiff, status, progress } where progress is a coarse 'dereferencing'|'diffing'|'done' signal.
steps.done_condition: hook exposes runDiff(oldSpec, newSpec) returning Promise<{ results, refsResolved }>

steps.description: Rewire DiffViewer.handleLoadSpecs: replace inline $RefParser.dereference + computeDiff with runDiff(). Emit progress into the same fetchStages state the FetchProgress banner already reads — add a 'Dereferencing $refs' and 'Computing diff' stage so the banner keeps animating while the worker runs.
steps.done_condition: large spec pair (e.g. GitHub 2022-11-28 -> 2026-03-10) dereferences + diffs without freezing the main thread; banner continues to animate through dereference and diff stages

steps.description: Add a cancel affordance: if the user cancels the compare (Reset button or nav) mid-run, the hook terminates the worker and spawns a fresh one. Keeps stale results from landing after the user moved on.
steps.done_condition: clicking Reset mid-run produces no results, no console errors

steps.description: Run bun run typecheck, bun run lint, hex analyze . — worker file lives under src/adapters/primary-like path, imports only from src/core/domain/* (no ports crossing). Domain stays pure.
steps.done_condition: typecheck/lint/analyze all pass; boundary rules respected
